influences.name: Flying Lotus
influences.context: The bass player was all over Lotus' 2010 album Cosmogramma, and especially present on the song 'Mmmhmm,' where Thundercat sings, too.

influences.name: Austin Peralta
influences.context: 'A Message For Austin / Praise the Lord / Enter the Void' is about jazz pianist Austin Peralta, who died suddenly of pneumonia when he was just 22. He was a dear friend of Thundercat and Flying Lotus
